verdict.rationale: An official CLI exists: it is documented at github.com/livekit/livekit-cli, and a hands-on probe confirmed `lk --version` (2.18.6) runs after a plain `brew install livekit-cli` with no key. The pack does not show which agent workflows the CLI covers. missing for 10: documentation of CLI commands for agent workflows (e.g. creating, deploying, or rolling back agents from the CLI), evidence of AI-native or coding-agent-oriented CLI usage, independent community corroboration of the CLI in practice.
